Button

Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.

Usage

Apply cu-button as the base class, then add a variant and size class.

Variants

Use variant classes to change the button's visual style. Each variant conveys a different level of emphasis or intent.

Sizes

Five sizes are available — from cu-button-xs to cu-button-xl. The default size is cu-button-md.

With Icons

Add inline SVG icons before or after the label text. Use cu-button-icon for icon-only buttons.

Disabled

Add the disabled attribute. The button becomes non-interactive with reduced opacity.
